title: MMRA: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Granularity and Multi-Image Relational Association Capabilities in Large Visual Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating large visual language models on multi-image relational association tasks, such as identifying similarities in materials, layouts, and spatial positions. While it includes a subtask for identifying emotional states (MentalitySimilarity), it does not have a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
